results.name: Empowered
results.description: The attack is cast at one level higher while still using the same spell slot as intended.

results.name: Dominating
results.description: Any saving throws induced by the spell are at disadvantage.

results.name: Quickened
results.description: The caster's bonus action can be used to cast any single action spell that they know.

results.name: Teleport
results.description: Attacker can teleport to any unoccupied space within 30 feet.

results.name: Supercharged
results.description: Any damage dice rolls count as maxed or the duration of the spell is doubled if there are no dice.

results.name: Instant Recall
results.description: The casting of the spell does not expend use of a spell slot.

results.name: Inspired
results.description: The next spell that the caster performs is at advantage.

results.name: Forked
results.description: An attack of opportunity can be taken to any adjacent target within range with an off-shoot of the original spell. This does half damage or has half duration and does not use any spell slots.

results.name: Intimidating
results.description: Any physical attacks against the caster made by any foes witnessing the spell are at disadvantage. This lasts until the caster takes damage.

results.name: Rout
results.description: Target must make a CHA saving throw (DC 15) or flee the battlefield. Sucess and the target is Frightened of the caster.
